limits: The source and its header both contain 75 coordinates; no native even frame is claimed.
The displayed reading is conditional on excluding one observed terminal X before inverse transposition, plus one observed-coordinate substitution.
Other endpoint exclusions preserve the same congratulation core with different opaque endpoints. The historical error location is not proved unique.

All 75 received-source and 75 inverse-stage exclusions are priced against the 36 fixed labels of the stated primary candidate; its one unknown label is unconstrained in that comparison. This is a fixed-target sensitivity test, not a language-independent historical uniqueness proof.
The unknown EK? position comes from an unassigned published key cell, not a missing source glyph. Its domain is 234789QY; no award class or other digit interpretation is selected.
JTN, KR, EK? and S R are retained without rank, name, award or signatory identification.

A second, stricter price additionally requires the unknown label to occupy an unassigned square cell; inverse-stage minima are 37 for the unconstrained-label convention and 38 for the domain-enforced convention.
